task: On Windows, write the Claude plugin's installed hooks in Claude Code exec form (absolute node.exe plus bin/codemie.js in args) and regenerate the installed hooks.json on every codemie-claude launch when it differs, leaving non-Windows, Gemini, Kimi and OpenCode hook handling unchanged.

key_reasoning.reason: Three components across utils, agent core and the Claude plugin: the shared hook-command resolver, the BaseExtensionInstaller template-method base and ClaudePluginInstaller. Base score M; raised to L once because the resolver and the base are shared with Gemini, Kimi, migration 006 and the codemie-code/OpenCode hook builder. The 'affects multiple agents' flag is not applied on top: their behaviour must stay unchanged, which is regression risk counted under technical_risk.

Closest precedents are the localizeInstalledHooks rewrite and the daemon-manager pattern of process.execPath plus a bin/*.js path resolved from the compiled module. Neither covers writing an args array, exec-form entries, or touching hooks on the already_exists path, and process.argv[1] is the wrong script source during an agent launch. Regression exposure through the shared base (Gemini must not change, Kimi has no hooks file) and order-sensitive installer mocks. Not raised to L: no auth, validation or injection surface (exec form removes the shell and the quoting), the 006 migration test already provides the rewrite / no-op / idempotence / write-failure template, platform spies exist, and rollback is trivial because the file is regenerated on every launch.

About 6 firm files: hook-command.ts, BaseExtensionInstaller.ts, claude.plugin-installer.ts and their three test files. Up to 2-3 more if the already_exists change reaches the Gemini installer test, the sso-claude-plugin integration test, or a new Claude installer test file. Upper end of M; a Claude-only seam keeps it there, a base-wide change would push it to L.

Mapped to the rubric taxonomy, not the repo's internal layers: Service (installer and hook resolution logic) and Infrastructure (the on-disk plugin install and node/bin paths). The Claude Code exec-form contract is consumed only as a file format, with no API, UI or persistence change.

Anchored on bundled example m/epmcdme-10203-add-rest-endpoint-with-business-logic (total 15). Same total, different profile: this task scores higher on component scope and technical risk, lower on requirements clarity and affected layers. Total sits on the 14/15 boundary and is not leaned down to S, because existing patterns do not cover the exec-form generation or the per-launch refresh, which are the bulk of the work. The only project example is in the L band and was not used.

red_flags_applied: Component Scope bumped from M to L: touches core shared utilities (hook-command resolver and BaseExtensionInstaller, shared by the Claude, Gemini and Kimi installers, migration 006 and the codemie-code hook builder)
